summary: Complete architectural audit and 9-phase implementation plan for rebuilding CGpedia into a multi-exam competitive examination and online test series platform across Web (Vercel PWA) and Android, featuring exact pixel-preserving logo cleanup (removing only the Telegram icon and swoosh), real-time Cloud Firestore synchronization, CBT exam engine, bilingual Hindi/English analytics, UPI QR + WhatsApp verification payments, and a role-protected Admin Control Center.
